request.query: coefficient height growth bound for polynomial long division by a monic divisor

items.name: Polynomial.divModByMonicAux
items.type: {R : Type u} → [inst : Ring R] → Polynomial R → {q : Polynomial R} → q.Monic → Polynomial R × Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.Monic.isUnit_leadingCoeff_of_dvd
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {a p : Polynomial R}, p.Monic → a ∣ p → IsUnit a.leadingCoeff

items.name: Polynomial.leadingCoeff_divByMonic_of_monic
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {p q : Polynomial R},
  q.Monic → q.degree ≤ p.degree → (p /ₘ q).leadingCoeff = p.leadingCoeff

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_modByMonic_mem_pow_natDegree_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S] (p q : Polynomial S)
  (Mp : Submodule R S),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), p.coeff i ∈ Mp) →
    1 ∈ Mp →
      ∀ (Mq : Submodule R S), (∀ (i : ℕ), q.coeff i ∈ Mq) → 1 ∈ Mq → ∀ (i : ℕ), (p %ₘ q).coeff i ∈ Mq ^ p.natDegree * Mp

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_divModByMonicAux_mem_span_pow_mul_span
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S] (p q : Polynomial S)
  (hq : q.Monic) (i : ℕ),
  (p.divModByMonicAux hq).1.coeff i ∈
      (1 ⊔ Submodule.span R (Set.range q.coeff)) ^ p.natDegree * (1 ⊔ Submodule.span R (Set.range p.coeff)) ∧
    (p.divModByMonicAux hq).2.coeff i ∈
      (1 ⊔ Submodule.span R (Set.range q.coeff)) ^ p.natDegree * (1 ⊔ Submodule.span R (Set.range p.coeff))

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_modByMonic_lt
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (p : Polynomial R) {q : Polynomial R}, q.Monic → q ≠ 1 → (p %ₘ q).natDegree < q.natDegree

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_modByMonic_le
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (p : Polynomial R) {g : Polynomial R}, g.Monic → (p %ₘ g).natDegree ≤ g.natDegree

items.name: Polynomial.degree_div_le
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Field R] (p q : Polynomial R), (p / q).degree ≤ p.degree
